fresh_pool.dominant_commercial_pattern: vertical SaaS or managed service, partner-led distribution, permissioned workflow-data asset

historical_overlap.smoke-bottleneck: medium-high, with a material change to ongoing fleet operations

selection_reason: The family-company portfolio and technicians make API coverage, support minutes, truck rolls, remote resolution, and willingness to fund a paid per-site pilot comparatively cheap to falsify.
primary_inherited_risk: OEM and distributor control of telemetry access can collapse the offer into service-heavy support without a durable data advantage.
